annotations.title: Sector market cap and volume over time

description: Returns the tracked companies as one market over time: combined market cap, each segment's or company's weight, and traded dollar volume — daily up to a year, weekly over five years; or, with `view: 'map'`, one session company by company. A past day's market cap is that day's close times the shares outstanding then (SEC filings); the last point is the latest session whose official closes are in, so during a session it is the previous one. `notes` explains units and gaps. Use it for how the sector, a segment or a company's weight has changed; for today, get_market_overview.

date.description: Map: a session date (YYYY-MM-DD) among the last 40; default the latest. A day without a session gives the latest session before it (`requestedDate` says so); a date before the sessions kept is refused.

points.description: Series: keep at most this many points, evenly spaced from the end (default 60, max 400).

sector.description: Series: 'all' (default) breaks the universe down by segment; a segment id — compute, interconnect, optics, memory, systems, power, neocloud, equipment, software, platform, other — breaks that segment down by company.

view.description: 'series' (default): totals and their breakdown over time. 'map': one session, company by company.

name: get_market
title: Sector market cap and volume over time
